changes.title: Helm values section `kafkaMirrorMaker.*` removed (4 keys)
changes.detail:
`kafkaMirrorMaker` of chart strimzi-kafka-operator no longer exists in 0.46.0. Remove these keys from your values and migrate the configuration they controlled; values set here no longer take effect (or are rejected when the chart validates values against a schema).
Removed keys:
kafkaMirrorMaker.image.name (default "kafka")
kafkaMirrorMaker.image.registry (default "")
kafkaMirrorMaker.image.repository (default "")
kafkaMirrorMaker.image.tagPrefix (default "")

changes.title: CRD `kafkamirrormakers.kafka.strimzi.io` (KafkaMirrorMaker) removed
changes.detail: 0.46.0 no longer ships this CustomResourceDefinition (versions v1beta2). Existing KafkaMirrorMaker resources are no longer reconciled; migrate or delete them before upgrading.

changes.title: The `ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure` feature gate moves to GA stage and is permanently enabled without the possibility to disable it
From Kafka 4.0.0, to enable the JMXReporter you must either enable metrics in `.spec.kafka.metrics`, or explicitly add JMXReporter in `metric.reporters`
Kafka 4.0 and newer is using Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1
changes.detail: Kafka 4.0 and newer is using Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1. If you have any custom logging configuration, you might need to update it during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.

changes.title: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the `regardingObject`. If you are using `regardingObject` as a `field-selector` for listing events…
changes.detail: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the `regardingObject`. If you are using `regardingObject` as a `field-selector` for listing events you must update the selector to specify the Kafka resource instead.

changes.title: Removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services
changes.detail: Removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services. * If you have any custom setup leveraging such label, please use the `strimzi.io/pod-name` one instead.

changes.title: Strimzi EnvVar Configuration Provider (deprecated in Strimzi 0.38.0) and Strimzi MirrorMaker 2 Extensions (deprecated in Strimzi 0.28.0) plugins were removed…
changes.detail: Strimzi EnvVar Configuration Provider (deprecated in Strimzi 0.38.0) and Strimzi MirrorMaker 2 Extensions (deprecated in Strimzi 0.28.0) plugins were removed from Strimzi container images. Please use the Apache Kafka EnvVarConfigProvider and Identity Replication Policy instead.

changes.title: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future
changes.detail: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future. To use the Open Policy Agent authorizer, you can use the `type: custom` authorization.

changes.title: The `secrets` list for mounting additional Kubernetes Secrets in `type: custom` authentication was deprecated and will be removed in the future
changes.detail: The `secrets` list for mounting additional Kubernetes Secrets in `type: custom` authentication was deprecated and will be removed in the future. Please use the template section to configure additional volumes instead.

changes.title: The storage overrides for configuring per-broker storage class are not supported anymore
changes.detail: The storage overrides for configuring per-broker storage class are not supported anymore. If you are using the storage overrides, you should instead use multiple KafkaNodePool resources with a different storage class each. For more details about migrating from storage overrides, please follow the documentation.

changes.title: When using Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands and upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, make sure the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate is…
changes.detail: When using Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands and upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, make sure the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSets` are used before upgrading.

changes.title: When using the Kafka operand and upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older, make sure the `UseStrimziPodSets` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSet` resources…
changes.detail: When using the Kafka operand and upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older, make sure the `UseStrimziPodSets` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSet` resources are used before upgrading.

changes.title: GHSA-mw9r-p8xp-wx96 (CVE-2026-55225) still affects target 0.46.0: Cross-namespace privilege escalation via `Kafka.spec.entityOperator`
changes.detail: Severity: high. Affected versions: <= 1.0.0. Patched: 1.0.1, 1.1.0. Consider upgrading to a patched release instead.

changes.title: GHSA-r427-j2h7-wv3m (CVE-2026-55226) still affects target 0.46.0: Unrestricted access to all Secrets within namespace watched by the Topic operator
changes.detail: Severity: medium. Affected versions: <= 1.0.0. Patched: 1.0.1, 1.1.0. Consider upgrading to a patched release instead.

changes.title: Support for MirrorMaker 1 has been removed
changes.detail: Support for MirrorMaker 1 has been removed. Please make sure to migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.

changes.title: Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed
changes.detail: Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed. Please make sure all your clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer!

changes.title: Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults
changes.detail: Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults. This will make the cluster boot up correctly in IPv6 only environments, where IPv4 preference will break it due to lack of IPv4 addresses.

evidence.excerpt: b5060222ffc07b67b7efe003bd326e48b2896fc8 refs/tags/0.45.0

* Add support for Kafka 3.9.0 and 3.8.1. 
  Remove support for Kafka 3.7.0 and 3.7.1
* Ability to move data between JBOD disks using Cruise Control.
* Allow using custom certificates for communication with container registry in Kafka Connect Build with Kaniko

* Only roll pods once for ClientsCa cert renewal.
  This change also means the restart reason ClientCaCertKeyReplaced is removed and either CaCertRenewed or CaCertHasOldGeneration will be used.
* Allow rolling update for new cluster CA trust (during Cluster CA key replacement) to continue where it left off before interruption without rolling all pods again.
* Update HTTP bridge to 0.31.1
* Add support for mounting CSI volumes using the `template` sections

* Add support for Kafka 4.0.0.
  Remove support for Kafka 3.8.0 and 3.8.1.
* Support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and for KRaft migration has been removed
* Support for MirrorMaker 1 has been removed
* Support for storage class overrides has been removed
* Added support to configure `dnsPolicy` and `dnsConfig` using the `template` sections.
* Store Kafka node certificates in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod.
* Allow configuring `ssl.principal.mapping.rules` and custom trusted CAs in Kafka brokers with `type: custom` authentication
* Moved HTTP bridge configuration to the ConfigMap setup by the operator.
* Dependency updates (Vert.x 4.5.14, Netty 4.1.118.Final)
* Moved Kafka Connect configuration to the ConfigMap created by the operator.
* Update Kafka Exporter to [1.9.0](https://github.com/danielqsj/kafka_exporter/releases/tag/v1.9.0)
* Adopted new Kafka Connect health check endpoint (see [proposal 89](https://github.com/strimzi/proposals/blob/main/089-adopt-connect-health-endpoint.md)).
* Update standalone User Operator to handle Cluster CA cert Secret being missing when TLS is not needed.
* Strimzi Drain Cleaner updated to 1.3.0 (included in the Strimzi installation files)

* Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults.
  This will make the cluster boot up correctly in IPv6 only environments, where IPv4 preference will break it due to lack of IPv4 addresses.
* Improved the MirrorMaker2 example Grafana dashboard to set metric units and include chart descriptions.
* The `ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure` feature gate moves to GA stage and is permanently enabled without the possibility to disable it.
* Update OAuth library to 0.16.2.
* Update HTTP bridge to 0.32.0.
* Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart updated to have the Kafka resource as the `regardingObject` and the Pod in the `related` field.
